digest.component_or_area: bridge execution layer and destructive-repair coordination
propositions: The bridge must execute uniformly across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged runner entrypoint without requiring repository-local scripts
Legacy reconcile command vocabulary, signatures, defaults, exit codes, and mutation boundaries must be preserved for existing checked-out workflows
Destructive-repair pause ownership (fsck --repair and doctor --repair) must be provider-neutral, using git-based durable coordination without GitHub CLI dependency

The runner-neutral bridge implementation and provider-neutral repair-pause implementation are independently releasable and must preserve all checked-out reconcile mode callers and existing published defaults
Repair pause safety must be owned by a single contract through refs/reconciler/gate with per-invocation tokens and CAS semantics, with no automatic retry reclaim
Local/GitHub/Jenkins/GitLab/bare execution routes exclusively through rebar bridge run with no external API surfaces or lower-trust-actor boundary crossing introduced
